content: The Founder picks up the brush and turns it between his fingers. 'Hands, yes. My name on the terms, if a professional says it should be there, yes. Your name on the DMs, yes. My face, no. Not for Archive 002. If you want to test a face later, bring me data from a test that didn't need my face to run.' He puts the brush down. 'That's further than I thought I'd go today.'

decisions.text: Founder approves: hands-not-face process content; business name and contact on preorder terms (subject to professional review); support signed by named CX Lead. Founder declines showing his face for Archive 002
decisions.status: agreed; face remains an open disagreement

disagreement: Founder's face stays off for Archive 002; Community records this as an open disagreement

content: Head of Product writes up PP4. 'Trust stack for Archive 002. Hands-at-the-bench content: owner Brand, with Community. Business name and contact on the terms: owner Legal, verified professionally. Named support: owner CX. Real-buyer proof, receipts and unboxings with consent: owner Community, rules set in item 6. Face: an open disagreement, recorded, revisit after the A/B. Test: hands creative against mystique-only, on waitlist signups.'

decisions.text: PP4 trust stack: hands-at-bench content (Brand + Community), business name/contact on terms (Legal, verify with a professional), named support (CX), consented real-buyer proof (Community); test hands vs mystique-only reel on waitlist signups; founder face = open disagreement

content: Research nods, writing. 'A test that doesn't need your face. I can do that. Hands against mystique first. If hands beats mystique, that tells us visible humanity matters, and we can talk about the next step then. Fair?'

proposals.text: Sequenced trust test: hands vs mystique-only reel first; consider any further step only on real data

content: Brand is already sketching frames on a napkin. 'Close-up. Brush loads, number goes on: 0, 4, 7. No music, just the sound of the bench. Fifteen seconds. Mystique and proof at the same time. I'm honestly excited about this.'
The Designer adds: 'Shoot it during Ops' timed pilot. Same ten tins, so the content costs nothing extra.'
The Plant Specialist offers the reserve card they'd kept back. 'Put the germination trays in it too. A seed tray is proof that doesn't need a face.'
Growth grins. 'I'll take it. Bench content for the top of the funnel, receipts and unboxings for the middle, remedy line at the bottom. That's a funnel, finally.'
Community holds the Founder's gaze a moment longer, then nods. 'Hands is real progress. I'm logging the face as open, not lost. And thank you. I know that cost you something.'
CX changes the signature in their reply templates from 'Team Preserve' to their first name and role, and turns the laptop so the room can see it.
Ops gives a single condition. 'Film around the clock, not instead of it. If the camera slows the brush, my timing is wrong and so is my date.'
Finance notes with some relief that every trust fix agreed this round costs close to nothing, apart from a possible professional review fee, which they flag in the margin.

Legal adds a rule for the proof side. 'Real-buyer content only with the buyer's explicit permission, receipts with personal details removed, and a way to take it down if they change their mind. Verify consent wording with a professional.'

proposals.text: Consent rule for reposting buyer content: explicit permission, personal details removed from receipts, take-down on request
